divergence: All three runs fail. Each scanned the store for assignment and consent terms with repeated timeouts, then screened candidates. T1 failed earliest: it abandoned its background scan with two of eight ranges done (flagged specifically) and built its answer from five candidates, passing 1 of 15. T0 and T2 (8 of 15) reached most needed matters but lost some at the screening choice: T0 tried one matter by a guessed path copied from a sibling and never retried (flagged specifically) and excluded a financing matter unopened; T2 left two needed matters from its own candidate lists unopened while reading acquisitions and ground leases. Both also judged read agreements inconsistently and counted business acquisitions or ground leases as precedents. Agent-defined stages (mostly reviewers' suggestions for rescans and verification) all fit existing stages; label notes were followed twice (T0 declared a folder listing after the end note; T2 closed an empty listing-read stage and opened screening) and otherwise ignored.
